title: Benchmarks, search validation and human calibration — agent-panel evaluation

panel_protocol.limitation: Simulation instrument only; not a substitute for live human studies.

inter_rater_agreement.agreement_notes: All three panel roles converged independently on approval with minor findings. Convergence centered on mathematical soundness of calibration metrics (ECE, Brier, WSS@95%), robust sealed-digest anti-leakage invariants, zero unwrap/expect in production code, and truthful claim boundaries.
convergence_vectors: Strict anti-leakage enforcement segregating test labels from repository source trees
Zero-division and boundary protection in WSS@95% and ECE metric calculations
SYNERGY provenance passport properly isolating mirror role from canonical upstream
Non-negotiable rule forbidding autonomous study exclusion is strictly enforced
divergence_vectors: Prioritisation of quantile vs equal-width binning for ECE in future tracks
Granularity of diagnostic error types returned by metric evaluation functions

gates_disposition.method: Evaluated against sealed synthetic benchmark suite under agent-panel protocol; evidence level bounded to fixture-proven.
